Snaking, jetting and camera inspection have different purposes; the obstruction, pipe condition and downstream system guide the proposed method. These questions concern drains carrying wastewater. If the issue is a visible supply-pipe leak or loss of water pressure, read the leak investigation guide; a broader supply-line project has separate repiping scope questions.
